# Godzilla Docs

> Everything you need to build data pipelines on the Godzilla platform.

## Pages
- [Changelog](https://localhost:4310/changelog): Recent changes to the Godzilla API and platform.
- [Concepts](https://localhost:4310/concepts): The core building blocks and key definitions of Godzilla: pipelines, connectors, events, schemas, and terminology.
- [Glossary (Moved)](https://localhost:4310/glossary): The Glossary has been folded into the Concepts page.
- [Godzilla Docs](https://localhost:4310/index): Everything you need to build data pipelines on the Godzilla platform.
- [Security & compliance overview](https://localhost:4310/security-and-compliance): How Godzilla handles data in transit and at rest, credential storage, and compliance posture.
- [Support / Contact](https://localhost:4310/support): Support and contact information has moved to Troubleshooting / FAQ.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ](https://localhost:4310/troubleshooting): Common problems and fixes across pipelines, connectors, and webhooks, plus support contact channels.

## api
- [API Reference](https://localhost:4310/api/index): The Godzilla REST API: pipelines (v3), connectors, transforms, events, webhooks, rate limits, and error reference.
- [Connectors endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/connectors): Create, list, and rotate credentials for connectors via the v2 REST API.
- [Error reference](https://localhost:4310/api/error-reference): The v2 API's error response shape, error codes, and migration details from v1.
- [Events endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/events): Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
- [Pipelines endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/pipelines): Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v3 REST API.
- [Pipelines endpoint (v2)](https://localhost:4310/api/pipelines-v2): Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v2 REST API (previous version).
- [Quotas & billing](https://localhost:4310/api/quotas-and-billing): Plan tiers, monthly event quotas, rate limits, and what happens when an account exceeds its quota.
- [Rate limits](https://localhost:4310/api/rate-limits-errors): Standard-tier rate limits, rate limit headers, and pagination envelope for the v2 API.
- [Transforms endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/transforms): Create and list transform steps for a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
- [Webhooks endpoint](https://localhost:4310/api/webhooks): Subscribe to Godzilla platform lifecycle events over outbound HTTP via the v2 REST API.

## concepts
- [Connectors](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-connectors): What a connector is in Godzilla: a pre-built integration to a source or destination system, with its own auth and catalog of built-in types.
- [Events](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-events): What an event is in Godzilla: the atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.
- [Pipelines](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-pipelines): What a pipeline is in Godzilla: a named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector through transform steps to a destination.
- [Schemas](https://localhost:4310/concepts/concepts-schemas): How event payload shapes are declared, validated, and evolved in Godzilla pipelines.

## getting-started
- [Authentication](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-authentication): Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.
- [Getting Started](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/index): Install the Godzilla SDKs, run your first pipeline with the quickstart, and configure authentication.
- [Installation](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-installation): Install the Godzilla SDK or start calling the REST API directly.
- [Quickstart](https://localhost:4310/getting-started/getting-started-quickstart): Go from zero to a running pipeline in five minutes.

## guides
- [Building your first pipeline](https://localhost:4310/guides/building-your-first-pipeline): Create a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that connects them, end to end.
- [Connecting a data source](https://localhost:4310/guides/connecting-a-data-source): Choose the right connector type and authentication method for a new data source.
- [Error handling & recovery](https://localhost:4310/guides/handling-errors-and-retries): How Godzilla retries failed events, when they're dead-lettered, and how to replay them.
- [Guides](https://localhost:4310/guides/index): Task-oriented walkthroughs for building, connecting, and operating Godzilla pipelines.
- [Monitoring & alerts](https://localhost:4310/guides/monitoring-and-alerts): Watch pipeline health and get notified of failures via webhooks before they become incidents.
- [Scheduling & triggers](https://localhost:4310/guides/scheduling-and-triggers): Run a pipeline on a cron schedule or trigger it directly from incoming events.
- [Transforming events in flight](https://localhost:4310/guides/transforming-events-in-flight): Reshape, filter, and enrich events as they pass through a pipeline.

## recipes
- [Backfill historical data](https://localhost:4310/recipes/backfill-historical-data): Techniques and configurations for loading historical data ranges through Godzilla pipelines.
- [Fan-out to multiple destinations](https://localhost:4310/recipes/fan-out-to-multiple-destinations): Route a single event stream to multiple heterogeneous storage engines, search indexes, and endpoints.
- [Recipes](https://localhost:4310/recipes/index): End-to-end configuration patterns and blueprints for common Godzilla pipeline use cases.

## sdks
- [Go SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/go): Install and use godzilla-go to manage pipelines and connectors from Go.
- [Node.js SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/node-js): Install and use @godzilla/sdk to manage pipelines and connectors from Node.js.
- [Python SDK](https://localhost:4310/sdks/python): Install and use godzilla-sdk to manage pipelines and connectors from Python.
- [SDKs](https://localhost:4310/sdks/index): Official Godzilla client libraries for Go, Node.js, and Python.

## versions
- [Migration guide (v1 → v2)](https://localhost:4310/versions/migration-guide-v1-to-v2): Move an existing v1 integration to the v2 API: cursor pagination, webhooks, and the new error shape.
- [Release notes archive](https://localhost:4310/versions/release-notes-archive): Older v1-era release notes, superseded by the current changelog.
